nef46f44dcfe.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's ranks reported in the Socio-Economic Survey?
o: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in egg production
Andhra Pradesh ranked first in milk production
Andhra Pradesh produced 139.46 lakh MT of milk
nef46f44dcfe.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked seventh, not first, in milk production (139.46 lakh MT); it ranked first in eggs with 2,739 crore.

n3610bdd5251.s: After reorganisation in 2014, how many Lok Sabha seats does Andhra Pradesh have?
n3610bdd5251.x: Andhra Pradesh has 25 Lok Sabha seats and Telangana 17; in the Assemblies the figures are 175 and 119.

n0aa72608a49.s: Which of the following pairs of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is correctly matched?
o: Section 46 – Grants and special development package for backward areas
Section 47 – Polavaram declared a national project
Section 90 – Common Governor for both States
n0aa72608a49.x: Section 46 provides grants and a special development package for backward areas, especially Rayalaseema and the north coastal districts. Common capital is Sec 5, Polavaram is Sec 90 and the common Governor is Sec 7.

nd018aa7f031.s:
Consider the following statements about the implementation of the Polavaram Project:
1. Land acquisition and delays in rehabilitation and resettlement funding have caused friction.
2. Shortage of coal for thermal power generation has caused friction.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nd018aa7f031.x: The friction points are revised cost estimates, land acquisition and R&R funding delays; coal shortage is not one of them. (A one-liner could not be built honestly, so a 2-statement set is used.)

nd9b799b683c.s:
Consider the following statements about the division of assets under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014:
1. Assets and commercial undertakings (Section 53) are divided by population ratio.
2. Treasury and bank cash balances (Section 49) are divided by population ratio.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nd9b799b683c.x: Cash balances under Section 49 go by population ratio; assets and commercial undertakings under Section 53 go by location, so statement 1 is wrong.

new.s: The last chapter of the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26 is:
new.x: SES 2025-26 has 11 chapters and its last is Data-Driven Governance; Progress Monitoring – KPIs and SDGs was the last chapter of SES 2024-25.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Socio-Economic Survey:
1. SES 2025-26 has 11 chapters.
2. The last chapter of SES 2025-26 is 'Progress Monitoring – KPIs and SDGs'.
3. Growth figures in SES 2025-26 are First Advance Estimates.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: SES 2025-26 has 11 chapters and uses First Advance Estimates; its last chapter is Data-Driven Governance, while Progress Monitoring – KPIs and SDGs closed SES 2024-25.

new.s: As per the 2025-26 FAE, Andhra Pradesh's per capita income grew by:
new.x: PCI rose 10.43% to ₹2,94,507; 10.75% and 9.88% are GSDP growth at current and constant prices.

new.s: Against Andhra Pradesh's per capita income of ₹2,94,507 in 2025-26, India's per capita income was:
new.x: India's per capita income was ₹2,19,575, well below Andhra Pradesh's ₹2,94,507.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's GSDP growth at current prices in 2025-26 (FAE) was:
new.x: GSDP at current prices grew 10.75% to ₹17.62 lakh crore; 9.88% is the constant-price (real) growth.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's sectoral growth in 2025-26 (FAE)?
o: Agriculture and allied was the fastest-growing sector
new.x: Services was the fastest-growing sector at 10.67%, ahead of agriculture and allied (10.14%) and industry (9.15%).

new.s: Which services sub-sector grew fastest in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
new.x: Banking was the top services sub-sector at 14.25%; Public Administration was the lowest at 0.09%.

new.s: Which agriculture sub-sector recorded the lowest growth in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
new.x: Forestry grew only 2.39%, the lowest; fishing and aquaculture was the fastest at 17.69%.

new.s: As per Census 2011, the literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: AP's literacy is 67.35%, below India's 72.98%; 29.47% is AP's urbanisation.

new.s: By area (1,62,970 sq km), Andhra Pradesh ranks in India:
new.x: AP is 8th by area and 10th by population share (4.09%); 2nd is its coastline rank.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's districts rose from 26 to 28 on 31 December 2025 with the creation of:
new.x: Polavaram and Markapuram districts took the count from 26 to 28 from 31 December 2025.

new.s: The Maternal Mortality Ratio (2018-20) of Andhra Pradesh, against India's 97, is:
new.x: AP's MMR is 45 against India's 97; 19 is AP's IMR.

new.s: As per SES 2024-25, the number of health sub-centres in Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: AP has 11,086 sub-centres; 1,145 is the number of rural PHCs.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about school education in Andhra Pradesh:
1. About 68.27 lakh students were enrolled in 2024-25.
2. In 2023-24 the dropout rate was highest at the I–V level.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Enrolment was 68.27 lakh; the dropout rate was highest at IX–XII (10.09%) and lowest at I–V (0.18%).

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's share in India's fish production is about:
new.x: AP produces about 29% of India's fish and ranks first.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's revenue deficit in 2025-26 RE was ₹41,118 crore, which is what share of GSDP?
new.x: The revenue deficit was 2.33% of GSDP; 4.57% is the fiscal deficit.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of Andhra Pradesh's national ranks is correctly matched?
new.x: AP is 2nd in raw silk; it is 4th in meat, 7th in milk and 6th in exports.

new.s: CORS (Continuously Operating Reference Stations) are used in Andhra Pradesh for:
new.x: The Survey reports CORS being used for the land resurvey.

new.s: In the ODOP-2024 awards, Andhra Pradesh won the State Award and how many of the 12 District Awards?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh won the ODOP-2024 State Award and 10 of the 12 District Awards.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about welfare delivery in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There are 15,004 village and ward secretariats.
2. Ward secretariats number 8,489.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: There are 15,004 village and ward secretariats, of which 3,863 are ward secretariats; 8,489 is the number of Rythu Seva Kendras.

new.s: How many ward secretariats are there in Andhra Pradesh as per the Survey?
new.x: There are 3,863 ward secretariats within 15,004 village and ward secretariats; 8,489 is the number of Rythu Seva Kendras.

new.s: The number of rural Self-Help Groups under SERP in Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: SERP has 8.34 lakh rural SHGs covering 84.47 lakh women.

new.s: Under NTR Bharosa, the amount released from December 2024 to November 2025 was:
new.x: ₹32,754.90 crore was released under NTR Bharosa; ₹1,554.06 crore was spent on Deepam-2.

new.s: How many beneficiaries were covered under Deepam-2, which gives three free LPG cylinders a year?
new.x: Deepam-2 covers 1.84 crore beneficiaries at a cost of ₹1,554.06 crore; 33.32 crore is Stree Shakti's free journeys.

new.s: Rythu Seva Kendras in Andhra Pradesh were earlier known as:
new.x: Rythu Seva Kendras are the former Rythu Bharosa Kendras; 8,489 are functional after rationalisation.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 consists of:
new.x: The Act has 12 Parts, 108 sections and 13 Schedules.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 is Act No. ____ of 2014.
new.x: It is Act No. 6 of 2014, published in Gazette No. 6.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014:
1. It divided the old State into two States, Telangana and residual Andhra Pradesh.
2. Telangana became the 29th State of India.
3. The Act has 12 Schedules.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Act created Telangana as the 29th State; it has 13 Schedules, not 12.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha on:
new.x: It was introduced on 13 February 2014, passed by the Lok Sabha on 18 February and by the Rajya Sabha on 20 February.

new.s: The Rajya Sabha passed the AP Reorganisation Bill by voice vote, without amendment, on:
new.x: The Rajya Sabha passed it on 20 February 2014; the Lok Sabha had passed it on 18 February.

new.s: Who was the President of India when the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 received assent?
new.x: President Pranab Mukherjee gave assent on 1 March 2014.

new.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 extended the term of the Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal?
new.x: Section 89 extends the KWDT term for project-wise allocation; Section 90 is Polavaram.

new.s: Which of the following pairs under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is NOT correctly matched?
o: Apex Council – chaired by the Union Water Resources Minister
new.x: The GRMB has its headquarters in Telangana; the KRMB is in Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: Under Section 93, the Centre was to take the Thirteenth Schedule measures within:
new.x: Section 93 gives the Centre 10 years to take the Thirteenth Schedule measures.

new.s: Under which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act was the 13th Finance Commission award split by population ratio and other parameters?
new.x: Section 46 splits the 13th FC award and provides a special development package for backward areas.

new.s: Which of the following parts of Section 94 is correctly matched?
o: 94(4) – Denotifying degraded forest land for the capital
new.x: 94(4) is denotifying degraded forest land for the capital; 94(1) is tax incentives, 94(2) backward-area infrastructure and 94(3) the new capital.

new.s: Which of the following seat allocations after reorganisation is correctly matched?
new.x: AP got 11 and Telangana 7 of the 18 Rajya Sabha seats; Lok Sabha is 25 and 17, Assembly 175 and 119.

new.s: In 2014, which district of Andhra Pradesh had the most Assembly constituencies?
new.x: East Godavari had the most (19), followed by Guntur (17).

new.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh had the fewest Assembly constituencies (9) in 2014?
new.x: Vizianagaram had 9 seats, the fewest; Srikakulam, Nellore and YSR Kadapa had 10 each.

new.s: Of the 175 Assembly seats of Andhra Pradesh, how many are reserved for SCs and STs respectively?
new.x: 29 seats are reserved for SCs and 7 for STs.

new.s: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, the Legislative Council of Andhra Pradesh may have:
new.x: AP's Council can have not more than 50 members; Telangana's has 40.

new.s: Which of the following Schedules of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is correctly matched with its subject?
o: Schedule XI – Coal, oil, gas and power
new.x: Schedule IX covers companies and corporations; VII is funds, VIII pension liability and XII coal, oil, gas and power.

new.s: The apportionment of pension liability is dealt with in which Schedule of the AP Reorganisation Act?
new.x: The Eighth Schedule (Section 59) apportions pension liability.

new.s: Under Schedule XII, APERC was to act as the joint regulator for up to:
new.x: APERC was joint regulator for up to six months; the SLDC was shared for up to two years.

new.s: Under Schedule XIII, a major port was to be developed at:
new.x: Schedule XIII commits a major port at Duggirajupatnam.

new.s: The Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor in Schedule XIII is modelled on:
new.x: The corridor is modelled on the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor (DMIC).

new.s: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh began functioning at Amaravati on:
new.x: It began on 1 January 2019; the Presidential order constituting it was of 26 December 2018.

new.s: The separate High Court for Andhra Pradesh was constituted by a Presidential order under which Article?
new.x: The 26 December 2018 order was made under Article 214 and the Act.

new.s: On which date did the AP Assembly pass the resolution to insert 'at Amaravati' in Section 5(2)?
new.x: The resolution was passed on 28 March 2026; Parliament passed the amendment in April 2026.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh High Court passed its order on the capital (Amaravati) on:
new.x: The High Court order on the capital was given on 3 March 2022.

new.s: Which States, besides Andhra Pradesh, still demand Special Category Status (as of January 2026)?
new.x: AP, Bihar and Odisha still demand SCS.

new.s: Special Category Status for Andhra Pradesh is provided under:
o: the Thirteenth Schedule of the APRA 2014
None of these; it is not in the Act
new.x: The APRA 2014 has no SCS clause; the demand rests on assurances outside the Act.

new.s: The special assistance measure in lieu of SCS was approved by the Union Cabinet on:
new.x: The Union Cabinet approved it on 15 March 2017.

new.s: How much was released for the Section 46(2) resource gap of Andhra Pradesh in 2014-15?
new.x: ₹2,303 crore was released in 2014-15, ₹500 crore in 2015-16 and ₹1,176.50 crore in 2016-17, totalling ₹3,979.50 crore.

new.s: The grant for backward districts of Andhra Pradesh is ₹350 crore a year for how many districts?
new.x: ₹350 crore a year goes to 7 backward districts of Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP.

new.s: Which provision of the AP Reorganisation Act provides fiscal measures including tax incentives?
new.x: 94(1) covers tax incentives; 94(2) backward-area infrastructure and 94(3) the new capital.

new.s: Section 46(2) of the AP Reorganisation Act provides for:
o: The Centre meeting the resource gap of residual AP
new.x: Under Section 46(2) the Centre meets the resource shortage of residual Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: The funds in the Seventh Schedule (provident, pension and insurance funds) are divided under Section 52 on the basis of:
new.x: Seventh Schedule funds are divided by population ratio under Section 52.

new.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act deals with tax refunds, shared in the ratio 58.32 : 41.68?
new.x: Section 56 shares tax refunds by population ratio; AP's loss was about ₹3,900 crore.

new.s: The irrigation potential of the Polavaram Project is about:
new.x: Polavaram will irrigate about 2.91 lakh ha in former East Godavari, Visakhapatnam, West Godavari and Krishna districts.

new.s: How much did the Union Budget 2026-27 provide for Polavaram towards its revised cost?
new.x: The Budget of 2 February 2026 gave ₹3,320 crore for Polavaram's revised cost.

new.s: The Apex Council under Section 84 of the AP Reorganisation Act consists of:
o: The Prime Minister and both Chief Ministers
The Union Water Resources Minister alone
The Union Water Resources Minister and both Chief Ministers
Both Chief Ministers and both Governors
new.x: The Apex Council has 3 members: the Union Water Resources Minister (chair) and both Chief Ministers.

new.s: The Godavari River Management Board (GRMB) has its headquarters in:
new.x: GRMB is headquartered in Telangana and KRMB in Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: The river management boards under Section 85 were to be set up within:
new.x: The boards were to be set up within 60 days, with security by CISF.

new.s: Under Schedule XI principles, no new project on the Krishna or Godavari can be taken up without the sanction of the:
new.x: No new project on Krishna or Godavari can come up without Apex Council sanction.

new.s: The SAIL steel plant feasibility study for Andhra Pradesh under the Thirteenth Schedule was for:
new.x: AP's steel plant study is for YSR district (Kadapa); Khammam is Telangana's plant.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the South Coast Railway zone:
1. Its headquarters is at Visakhapatnam.
2. It is India's 18th railway zone.
3. It became operational on 1 June 2024.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: South Coast Railway, India's 18th zone, is headquartered at Visakhapatnam and is operational from 1 June 2026, not 2024.

new.s: The refinery and petrochemical complex under the Thirteenth Schedule is linked to:
new.x: The refinery and petrochemical complex is at Kakinada, a GAIL-HPCL 50:50 JV.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments to Andhra Pradesh?
o: International-standard airports at Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati
Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor modelled on DMIC
new.x: Metro rail is for Visakhapatnam and the Vijayawada-Guntur-Tenali region, not Tirupati.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about central institutions in Andhra Pradesh:
1. IISER is located at Tirupati.
2. IIPE is located at Visakhapatnam.
3. IIITDM is located at Kurnool.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: IISER (with IIT) is at Tirupati, IIPE (with IIM) at Visakhapatnam and IIITDM at Kurnool.

new.s: The Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: The Central Tribal University is at Vizianagaram; the Central University is at Anantapur.

new.s: The NIT of Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: NIT is at Tadepalligudem; AIIMS is at Mangalagiri and IIIT at Sri City.

new.s: Under Section 8, in discharging his special responsibility the Governor consults the:
new.x: He uses individual judgment after consulting the Telangana Council of Ministers, and his decision is final.
